subject: Odinforce (Marvel)
title: What is the Odinforce? Thor's golden power-up in Avengers: Doomsday
answer: The Odinforce is the near-limitless magical energy of Odin, the ruler of Asgard, in Marvel comics, and it passes to whoever becomes the All-Father. Fans are searching for it because the final Avengers: Doomsday trailer shows Thor struck by yellow-gold lightning instead of his usual blue, which many read as Thor finally gaining it.
body:
In the comics, the Odinforce (also called the Odinpower) is the source of Odin's strength beyond the other Asgardian gods. Walter Simonson's run on Thor gave it an origin story: Odin and his brothers, Vili and Ve, stole the Eternal Flame from the fire demon Surtur, and when the brothers died their power merged with Odin's. The force is tied to the throne of Asgard, so it passes to the next All-Father. Using too much of it forces the wielder into the Odinsleep, a deep recharging sleep.

Thor has carried it in the comics after Odin's deaths, most famously in stories where he rules Asgard himself. With it, a wielder can teleport, travel through time, enchant objects and people, and fight cosmic-level enemies. In the movies it has never been named, although the Odinsleep was mentioned and some fans read Thor's new tricks in Thor: Love and Thunder as early signs of it.

The term spiked after Marvel released the final Avengers: Doomsday trailer on Nov. 23, 2026. In one shot, Thor raises a hand in a forest and is hit by lightning that glows yellow-gold rather than blue. An earlier teaser showed him praying to Odin for "the strength of the All-Fathers," so fans connected the two scenes, and comic book sites said the trailer points to an Odinforce upgrade. Marvel has not used the word itself, so how the film handles it is still unconfirmed.

If you hear someone say Thor "has the Odinforce now," they mean he has inherited his father's power and is stronger than ever, likely for a rematch with Doctor Doom, played by Robert Downey Jr. Avengers: Doomsday, directed by Anthony and Joe Russo with Chris Hemsworth back as Thor, opens in U.S. theaters Dec. 18, 2026.
in_the_news: The final Avengers: Doomsday trailer, released Nov. 23, 2026, shows Thor charged with yellow-gold lightning, sending fans searching for the Odinforce.

faq.q: Does Thor get the Odinforce in Avengers: Doomsday?
faq.a: The final trailer strongly hints at it with a shot of Thor hit by yellow-gold lightning, but Marvel has not confirmed the word or the storyline. The film opens Dec. 18, 2026.

faq.q: Why is Thor's lightning yellow in the new trailer?
faq.a: Fans and entertainment sites read the gold color as the Odinforce, Odin's power passing to Thor, instead of his usual blue lightning.

faq.q: Where does the Odinforce come from?
faq.a: In the comics, it formed when the life forces of Odin's brothers Vili and Ve merged with his after they helped him steal the Eternal Flame from Surtur.
A deep sleep the Odinforce user falls into to recharge after spending too much of the power. It also appears in the Thor films.
